نَهْدَآءُ [fem. of أَنْهَدُ] An elevated sand, (S, L, K,) like a compact hill, fertile, producing trees: (L:) or a tract of ground such as is called نَفْخَآءُ, but more flat and extensive: (L, art. نفخ:) it is used as an epithet; but not the masc. أَنْهَدُ. (L.) ―
-b2- هُوَ أَنْهَدُ القَوْمِ He is the strongest and hardiest of the people. (R.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
